newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Americans, Frenchman fined after Trinidad pub raid.
newsitem.headline: Americans, Frenchman fined after Trinidad pub raid.

text.p: Three Americans and a Frenchman were among 18 people arrested when police raided a pub and found women dancing on tabletops in their underclothes, officials were quoted on Wednesday as saying.

The Caribbean News Agency quoted police as saying that about 200 people were at the popular Attic pub in northern Trinidad when they made the raid early on Tuesday and found women dancing to soft music and men stuffing money into dancers' bras.
Police charged 18 people and let the rest of the crowd leave. A warrant was issued for the club's owner.

CANA said Americans Derrick Johnson and Kyle Nordle and Frenchman Lionel Prevault pleaded guilty to charges of aiding and abetting indecent exposure and indecent attire. They were fined the equivalent of $84 each.
Lawyers for the foreigners said their clients did not know it was illegal to be engaged in such shows in Trinidad, CANA reported.
Another American, Shawna Hilton, pleaded not guilty and was released on bail.
The foreigners' hometowns were not known.
